# Secure Fit LLC

> OSHA-compliant qualitative respiratory fit testing in New York City ($75 per test), with digital e-cards, instant QR verification, and pop-up appointment locations in Manhattan and Brooklyn.

Secure Fit LLC provides fast, documented respiratory fit testing aligned with OSHA 29 CFR 1910.134 Appendix A for healthcare workers, nursing and medical students, schools, and workplaces. Every passed test includes a digital e-card with a scannable QR code for employer or school verification, and records are kept on file for up to 3 years. Testing is $75 per fit test at Manhattan and Brooklyn pop-up locations by appointment (contact SecureFit2024@gmail.com, Securefit.bk@gmail.com, or +1 646 748 3677).
